name: gdc-varepop-apollo
description: This collection contains subjects from the Research for Precision Oncology Program (RePOP) network, a research activity that established a cohort of Veterans diagnosed with cancer and had genomic analyses performed on their tumor tissue as part of the standard of care. All data relevant to a patient's cancer and cancer care were collected under RePOP, including patient demographics, comorbidities, genomic analysis, treatments, medications, lab values, imaging studies, and outcomes. Please see the VAREPOP-APOLLO page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.
citeAs: The Veterans Affairs Precision Oncology Data Repository, a Clinical, Genomic, and Imaging Research Database.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
